```{r read in and format shapefiles of a world map, and ecoregion boundaries}

# Load world boundaries and ecoregion polygons as SpatVector objects
# had to switch to terra from sp because sp was deprecated in 2023
wlrd.p <- terra::vect(file.path(shapefiles_directory, 'TM_WORLD_BORDERS_SIMPL_PC150.shp'))
ECO <- terra::vect(file.path(shapefiles_directory, 'ecoregion_exportPolygon.shp'))

# Example: Print summary info for SpatVector objects
print(ECO)
print(wlrd.p)

# Assign coordinates for point data (lon/lat)
coral_cover_data$lat <- coral_cover_data$Latitude.Degrees
coral_cover_data$lon <- coral_cover_data$Longitude.Degrees
coral_cover_data$Longitude <- coral_cover_data$lon

# Convert coral_cover_data to a SpatVector of points using lon/lat (WGS84),
# then project to the ecoregion CRS before extracting polygon attributes.
coral_cover_points <- terra::vect(coral_cover_data, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
coral_cover_points <- terra::project(coral_cover_points, terra::crs(ECO))
eco_extracted <- terra::extract(ECO, coral_cover_points)

table(is.na(eco_extracted$ERG))
head(unique(eco_extracted$Ecoregion), 20)


# spatially plot points which don't have an ecoregion assigned
# Convert the 'ECO' SpatVector to an sf object for use with ggplot2::geom_sf
ECO_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(ECO)

# Plot: world polygons and highlight points with missing ERG
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ECO_sf) +
  geom_point(
    data = coral_cover_data[is.na(coral_cover_data$ERG), ],
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    color = "red"
  )
  # xlim(120, 180) +
  # ylim(-20, 20)

# Write extracted values directly to avoid duplicate ERG/Ecoregion columns
# (which can happen with cbind and cause coral_cover_data$ERG to reference stale NA values).
coral_cover_data <- as.data.frame(coral_cover_data)
coral_cover_data$ERG <- eco_extracted$ERG
coral_cover_data$Ecoregion <- eco_extracted$Ecoregion

# remove "ID" column added by terra::extract if present
if ("ID" %in% colnames(coral_cover_data)) {
  coral_cover_data$ID <- NULL
}

# Use data_for_maps.csv as the trusted reef -> ecoregion/diversity mapping (in order to recreate the paper exactly).
# This flags spatial-join disagreements while preserving the curated mapping.
data_for_maps <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "data_for_maps.csv"), header=TRUE)
trusted_mapping <- data_for_maps %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Reef_ID = as.character(Reef_ID),
    trusted_ecoregion = as.character(Ecoregion.x),
    trusted_erg = as.character(ERG),
    diversity.standardized = as.numeric(diversity.standardized)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Reef_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

coral_cover_data <- coral_cover_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Reef_ID = as.character(Reef_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trusted_mapping, by = "Reef_ID")

missing_trusted <- is.na(coral_cover_data$trusted_ecoregion)
if (any(missing_trusted)) {
  message(sprintf(
    "No trusted data_for_maps mapping for %d pre-filter row(s). Example reef_id(s): %s",
    sum(missing_trusted),
    paste(head(coral_cover_data$Reef_ID[missing_trusted], 5), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

mapped_trusted <- !missing_trusted
region_disagreement <- mapped_trusted &
  !is.na(coral_cover_data$Ecoregion) &
  !is.na(coral_cover_data$trusted_ecoregion) &
  trimws(tolower(as.character(coral_cover_data$Ecoregion))) !=
  trimws(tolower(as.character(coral_cover_data$trusted_ecoregion)))
if (any(region_disagreement)) {
  message(sprintf(
    "data_for_maps.csv ecoregion mapping overrides %d row(s) from the spatial join.",
    sum(region_disagreement)
  ))
  print(unique(coral_cover_data[region_disagreement, c("Reef_ID", "Ecoregion", "trusted_ecoregion")]))
}

coral_cover_data$Ecoregion[mapped_trusted] <- coral_cover_data$trusted_ecoregion[mapped_trusted]
coral_cover_data$ERG[mapped_trusted] <- coral_cover_data$trusted_erg[mapped_trusted]
coral_cover_data$trusted_ecoregion <- NULL
coral_cover_data$trusted_erg <- NULL
```

```{r standardize explanatory variables}

X_raw <- data[c('lon', 'lat', 'Depth', 'Human_pop', 'Cyclone', 'SST_mean', 'SST_max', 'SST_stdev', 'SSTA_min', 'SSTA_max', 'SSTA_Mean', 'SSTA_stdev', 'SSTA_freqmax', 'SSTA_freqstdev', 'SSTA_dhwmean', 'SSTA_dhwmax', 'TSA_min', 'TSA_max', 'TSA_mean', 'TSA_freqstdev', 'TSA_dhwmean', 'TSA_dhwmax', 'TSA_dhwstdev', 'Turbidity_mean', 'Turbidity_max', 'Historical_SST_max', 'Historical_SST_mean', 'Historical_SST_sd')]

X_raw$lat <- abs(X_raw$lat)

standardize_function<-function(x){
  x.standardized=(x-mean(na.omit(x)))/sd(na.omit(x))
  return(x.standardized)
}

X_standardized <- X_raw
for(i in 1:ncol(X_raw)){
  X_standardized[,i] <- standardize_function(X_raw[,i])
}

# get the ecoregion names of any nan values of diversity.standardized
nan_ecoregions <- data$Ecoregion[is.na(data$diversity.standardized)]
print(nan_ecoregions)
if (length(nan_ecoregions) > 0) {
  stop("Model-ready rows are missing trusted diversity.standardized values.")
}
```

```{r create a dataframe containing information for each site, with the ecoregion it belongs to, and the standardized diversity value}

# ensure that Reef_ID is a factor (forcing through as.character prevents potential issues with level order/persistence)
data$Reef_ID <- as.factor(as.character(as.factor(data$Reef_ID)))

# create a dataframe with unique combinations of Reef_ID and Ecoregion (i.e., a site-region index)
sites_and_region_df <- data %>% 
  distinct(Reef_ID, Ecoregion) %>%  # retain only one row per unique site-region combo
  ungroup()                         # remove any groupings

# assign a numeric site index to each unique Reef_ID (for use as a random effect grouping variable)
sites_and_region_df$site <- as.numeric(as.factor(sites_and_region_df$Reef_ID))

# assign a numeric region index to each unique Ecoregion (also for hierarchical modeling/random effects)
sites_and_region_df$region <- as.numeric(as.factor(sites_and_region_df$Ecoregion))

# create a dataframe mapping each ecoregion to a standardized diversity value,
# together with its numeric index (region) and sorted by that index
region_diversity_df <- data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Ecoregion, diversity.standardized) %>%  # unique rows for each region/diversity combo
  dplyr::mutate(region = as.numeric(as.factor(Ecoregion))) %>%  # assign numeric region index
  dplyr::arrange(region)                                        # sort by the region index

# Attach site/region indices to each observation row (required for JAGS random effects).
data <- left_join(data, sites_and_region_df[, c("Reef_ID", "site", "region")], by = "Reef_ID")

```


```{r define, initialize, and run the beta model. Save some output in csvs}

X <- model.matrix(~ lat + Depth + Human_pop + Cyclone + SST_mean + SSTA_Mean + SSTA_min + SSTA_freqstdev + SSTA_dhwmax + TSA_max + TSA_freqstdev + Turbidity_mean + Historical_SST_max, data =X_standardized)


K <- ncol(X)

N <- nrow(data)
Nre  = length(unique(data$site))
re   = data$site
R    = length(unique(data$ERG))

if (Nre == 0 || all(is.na(re))) {
  stop("`data$site` was not populated. Check the Reef_ID -> site join above.")
}
if (nrow(region_diversity_df) != R) {
  stop("Region-diversity vector length does not match R.")
}

data$coral_cover_Beta <- (data$Average_coral_cover * (N - 1) + 0.5) / N

win.data <- list(Y    = data$coral_cover_Beta,
                 N    = N,
                 X    = X,
                 K    = K,
                 re   = re, #Site
                 R    = R,
                 Nre  = Nre, #J
                 region_for_each_site = as.factor(as.character(sites_and_region_df$region)),
                 diversity = region_diversity_df$diversity.standardized
)
getwd()
sink(file.path(output_directory, "GLMM_coral_cover.txt"))
cat("
    model{
    #1A. Priors
    for (i in 1:K) { beta[i]  ~ dnorm(0, 0.0001) }
    for (i in 1:Nre) {a[i] ~ dnorm(ecoregion[region_for_each_site[i]], tau)}
    # Hierarchical effects
    for(z in 1:R){ # R is total number of ecoregions
    ecoregion[z] ~ dnorm(g[z],tau_ecoregion)
    g[z] <- mu_global + beta_diversity*diversity[z]
    }
    mu_global ~ dnorm(0, 0.0001) # prior for global mean
    beta_diversity ~ dnorm(0, 0.0001) #prior for the slope for diversity
    
    #1B.
    num   ~ dnorm(0, 0.0016) 
    denom ~ dnorm(0, 1)
    sigma <- abs(num / denom)
    
    num_ecoregion   ~ dnorm(0, 0.0016) 
    denom_ecoregion ~ dnorm(0, 1)
    sigma_ecoregion <- abs(num_ecoregion / denom_ecoregion)
    
    #1C. half-Cauchy(25) prior tau
    tau   <- 1 / (sigma * sigma)
    numtheta   ~ dnorm(0, 0.0016) 
    denomtheta ~ dnorm(0, 1)
    theta <- abs(numtheta / denomtheta)
    
    tau_ecoregion   <- 1 / (sigma_ecoregion * sigma_ecoregion)

#2. Likelihood 
    for (i in 1:N){       
      Y[i]       ~ dbeta(shape1[i], shape2[i])
      shape1[i] <- theta * pi[i]        #a
      shape2[i] <- theta * (1 - pi[i])  #b
      
      logit(pi[i]) <- eta[i]
      eta[i]<- inprod(beta[], X[i,]) + a[re[i]]
      

      ExpY[i] <- pi[i] 
      VarY[i] <- pi[i] * (1 - pi[i])  / (theta + 1)
      PRes[i] <- (Y[i] - ExpY[i]) / sqrt(VarY[i])

      #Discrepancy measures (used for checking overdispersion)
      YNew[i]   ~ dbeta(shape1[i], shape2[i])   #New data
      PResNew[i] <- (YNew[i] - ExpY[i]) / sqrt(VarY[i])
      D[i]       <- pow(PRes[i], 2)
      DNew[i]    <- pow(PResNew[i], 2)
  } 
    Fit         <- sum(D[1:N])
    FitNew      <- sum(DNew[1:N]) 
}
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

#Set the initial values for the betas and sigma to be input to the beta model
init_seed <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("BETA_INIT_SEED", unset = "20260529"))

#Parameters to estimate and save
params <- c("beta", "beta_diversity", "a", "theta", "PRes", "Fit", "FitNew",
            "YNew", "ecoregion", "sigma", "sigma_ecoregion", "mu_global")

model_path <- file.path(output_directory, "GLMM_coral_cover.txt")

J0 <- run_centered_jags_fit(
  win.data = win.data,
  model_path = model_path,
  params = params,
  K = K,
  Nre = Nre,
  mcmc_cfg = mcmc_cfg,
  init_seed = init_seed,
  progress_bar = if (BETA_SMOKE) "none" else "text"
)

if (isTRUE(mcmc_cfg$run_large)) {
  large_cfg <- list(
    n_chains = 6L,
    n_burnin = 10000L,
    n_iter = 20000L,
    n_thin = 10L,
    use_parallel = mcmc_cfg$use_parallel
  )
  J0_large <- run_centered_jags_fit(
    win.data = win.data,
    model_path = model_path,
    params = params,
    K = K,
    Nre = Nre,
    mcmc_cfg = large_cfg,
    init_seed = init_seed + 1L,
    progress_bar = "text"
  )

  model_fp <- file.path(output_directory, "saved_parallel_model_large.RData")
  save(J0_large, file = model_fp)
}

setwd(home)
Sys.sleep(1)
source(file= "MyBUGSOutput.R")

out <- J0$BUGSoutput

eco_random_effects<-cbind(ERG=levels(as.factor(as.character(data$ERG))), random_effect=as.numeric(out$mean$ecoregion))
write.csv(eco_random_effects, file = file.path(output_directory,'ecoregion_random_effect.csv'),row.names=F)

vars <- c("beta[2]","beta[3]","beta[4]","beta[5]", "beta[6]", "beta[7]", "beta[8]", "beta[9]", "beta[10]", "beta[11]", "beta[12]", "beta[13]", "beta[14]", "beta_diversity")

OUT0 <- MyBUGSOutput(J0$BUGSoutput, vars)
OUT1 <- round(OUT0, digits=2)

J1_df=data.frame(variableJ1=c("Latitude", "Depth", "Human_pop", "Cyclone",  "SST_mean", "SSTA_Mean", "SSTA_min", "SSTA_freqstdev", "SSTA_dhwmax", "TSA_max", "TSA_freqstdev", "Turbidity_mean", "Historical_SST_max", "Diversity"), MeanJ1=OUT1[,1], Down=OUT1[,3], Up=OUT1[,4], Down_quarter=OUT1[,5], Up_quarter=OUT1[,6])

write.csv(J1_df, file = file.path(output_directory,'beta_est.csv'),row.names=F)
```

```{r convergence_diagnostics}
cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n")
cat(paste("CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS (R-hat)\n"))
cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n\n")


# out <- J0$BUGSoutput
out <- J0$BUGSoutput

# Extract coefficient estimates
# Note: beta[1] is intercept, beta[2] is latitude, etc.
# XXX: The original script uses a custom `MyBUGSOutput()` helper to format
# beta summaries (means and quantiles) into `beta_est.csv`. Here we recreate
# those summaries manually from the posterior samples. Small differences in
# rounding, quantile definition, or variable ordering may mean that
# `beta_est_from_preprocessed.csv` is not byte-for-byte identical to the
# original `beta_est.csv`, even if the underlying posterior is the same.
beta_names <- c("Intercept", "Latitude", "Depth", "Human_pop", "Cyclone", 
                "SST_mean", "SSTA_Mean", "SSTA_min", "SSTA_freqstdev", 
                "SSTA_dhwmax", "TSA_max", "TSA_freqstdev", "Turbidity_mean", 
                "Historical_SST_max")

cat(paste("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n"))
cat(paste("COEFFICIENT ESTIMATES\n"))
cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n\n")

# Print coefficient summary
for (i in 1:K) {
  beta_samples <- out$sims.list$beta[, i]
  cat(paste(sprintf("%20s: mean=%7.4f, sd=%6.4f, 2.5%%=%7.4f, 97.5%%=%7.4f\n",
              beta_names[i],
              mean(beta_samples),
              sd(beta_samples),
              quantile(beta_samples, 0.025),
              quantile(beta_samples, 0.975))))
}

cat(paste(sprintf("\n%20s: mean=%7.4f, sd=%6.4f, 2.5%%=%7.4f, 97.5%%=%7.4f\n",
            "beta_diversity",
            mean(out$sims.list$beta_diversity),
            sd(out$sims.list$beta_diversity),
            quantile(out$sims.list$beta_diversity, 0.025),
            quantile(out$sims.list$beta_diversity, 0.975))))


for (val in names(out$sims.list)) {
  cat(paste(sprintf("%20s: mean=%7.4f, sd=%6.4f\n",
            val,
            mean(out$sims.list[[val]]),
            sd(out$sims.list[[val]]))))
}


            
# Rows = coefficient parameters you care about
coef_rows <- c(paste0("beta[", 1:K, "]"), "beta_diversity")
# coef_rows <- c(paste0("beta[", 1:K, "]"), "beta_diversity")
coef_rows <- c(paste0("beta[", 1:K, "]"), params[params != "beta"])

# Keep only rows that were actually monitored
coef_rows <- intersect(coef_rows, rownames(out$summary))

# Columns = summary stats you want to inspect
diag_cols <- intersect(c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "Rhat", "n.eff"),
                       colnames(out$summary))

coef_summary <- out$summary[coef_rows, diag_cols, drop = FALSE]
print(coef_summary)

param_names <- rownames(out$summary)
beta_params <- grep("^beta\\[", param_names, value = TRUE)
# Actual covariate names in the same order as beta indices
# (model.matrix includes "(Intercept)" first)
x_names <- colnames(X)
# Build lookup: beta[1] -> (Intercept), beta[2] -> lat, ...
beta_lookup <- setNames(x_names, paste0("beta[", seq_along(x_names), "]"))
# Optional prettier labels
pretty_lookup <- beta_lookup
pretty_lookup["beta[1]"] <- "Intercept"
# Apply to beta params
beta_labels <- unname(pretty_lookup[beta_params])
# Example: print Rhat with human-readable names
# Fix: The original indexing with | is not valid. Properly concatenate the two sets of row names and subset by them.
selected_params <- unique(c(beta_params, params[params != "beta"]))
selected_params <- intersect(selected_params, rownames(out$summary))
coef_summary <- out$summary[selected_params, c("mean", "sd", "Rhat", "n.eff"), drop = FALSE]
for (bp in beta_params) {
  idx <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == bp)
  if (length(idx) == 1L && bp %in% names(pretty_lookup)) {
    rownames(coef_summary)[idx] <- pretty_lookup[[bp]]
  }
}
print(coef_summary)
```

```{r calculate future coral cover expectations for years 2050 and 2100 under climate change scenarios RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 for low turbidity reefs}

Y_New_Beta <- (Y_New * (N - 1) + 0.5) / N

x_vals=seq(from=0, to=100, by=.001)
y_vals=x_vals

Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050 <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = dim(X)[1], ncol = 1))
Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_original <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = dim(X)[1], ncol = 1))
X_future<-X

X_future[,4]<-(data$human_pop_2050_vals-(mean(data$Human_pop)))/sd(data$Human_pop)
X_future[,6]<-(data$sst_mean_rcp45_2050-(mean(data$SST_mean)-273.15))/sd(data$SST_mean)


for (i in 1:dim(X_future)[1]){
  if (!is.na(X_future[i,6])){
    #X columns that were significant: intercept (1), latitude (2),  depth (3), Human_pop (4), Cyclone (5),  SST_mean (6), SSTA_Mean(7), ssta_freqstdev (9), Turbidity_mean (13), Historical_SST_max (14): so # 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 13, 14
    p <- boot::inv.logit(out$mean$beta[1]*X_future[i,1] + out$mean$beta[2]*X_future[i,2] + out$mean$beta[3]*X_future[i,3] + out$mean$beta[4]*X_future[i,4] + out$mean$beta[5]*X_future[i,5] + out$mean$beta[6]*X_future[i,6] + out$mean$beta[7]*X_future[i,7] + out$mean$beta[9]*X_future[i,9] + out$mean$beta[13]*X_future[i,13] + out$mean$beta[14]*X_future[i,14] +  out$mean$a[re[i]])
    shape1 <- out$mean$theta * p
    shape2 <- out$mean$theta * (1 - p)
    Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_Beta <- mean(rbeta(n=1000, shape1=shape1, shape2=shape2))
    Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050[i,1]<-((Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_Beta*N)-0.5)/(N-1)
    
    # 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 13, 14
    p_original <- boot::inv.logit(out$mean$beta[1]*X[i,1] + out$mean$beta[2]*X[i,2] + out$mean$beta[3]*X[i,3] + out$mean$beta[4]*X[i,4] + out$mean$beta[5]*X[i,5] + out$mean$beta[6]*X[i,6] + out$mean$beta[7]*X[i,7] + out$mean$beta[9]*X[i,9] + out$mean$beta[13]*X[i,13] + out$mean$beta[14]*X[i,14] +  out$mean$a[re[i]])
    shape1 <- out$mean$theta * p_original
    shape2 <- out$mean$theta * (1 - p_original)
    Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_Beta_original <- mean(rbeta(n=1000, shape1=shape1, shape2=shape2))
    Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_original[i,1]<-((Y_future_RCP45_yr_2050_Beta_original*N)-0.5)/(N-1)
  }
}
```

```{r Table 1. calculate coral cover per ocean, without pseudo-replicating}
reef_list<-unique(data$Reef_ID)
ocean_list<-c()
coral_cover_list<-c()
days_since_19811231_list<-c()

for(i in 1:length(reef_list)){
  days_since_19811231<-rev(sort(data[data$Reef_ID==reef_list[i],]$days_since_19811231))[1]
  days_since_19811231_list<-append(days_since_19811231_list, days_since_19811231)
  
  cc<-mean(data[data$Reef_ID==reef_list[i],][data[data$Reef_ID==reef_list[i],]$days_since_19811231==days_since_19811231,]$Average_coral_cover)
  coral_cover_list<-append(coral_cover_list, cc)
  
  ocean<-as.character(data[data$Reef_ID==reef_list[i],][data[data$Reef_ID==reef_list[i],]$days_since_19811231==days_since_19811231,]$Ocean[1])
  ocean_list<-append(ocean_list, ocean)
  
}

mean_cc_per_ocean_df<-data.frame("reef"=reef_list, "ocean"=ocean_list, "coral_cover"=coral_cover_list)
```
